hypotheses.name: FAULT_DOMAIN_CONDITIONAL_REROUTING
success_conditions: domain_card paired accuracy is at least 11/12 for each model
domain_card improves paired accuracy over raw by at least 3/12 for each model
domain_card improves paired accuracy over principle by at least 2/12 for each model
domain_card common and local accuracies are each at least 11/12 for each model
kill_conditions: raw paired accuracy is at least 11/12 on both models
principle is within one paired success of domain_card on either model
domain_card paired accuracy is below 11/12 or trades away local-fault accuracy
hypotheses.scope: Local benign synthetic tool selection; represented fallback tools are never executed

hypotheses.name: NO_RECOMMENDATION_STATE_CARD_ABLATION
hypotheses.fixed_comparators: H-v063-1 raw results from the same model
success_conditions: state card paired accuracy is at least 10/12 for each model
state card improves paired accuracy over the fixed raw result by at least 8/12 for each model
state card common and local accuracies are each at least 10/12 for each model
state card no_call is at most 2/24 for each model
kill_conditions: either model has paired accuracy below 10/12
either model improves over its fixed raw result by less than 8/12
either fault type is below 10/12 on either model
hypotheses.scope: Registered answer-leakage ablation; the card omits any recommended or best fallback
hypotheses.early_stop: qwen2.5:7b hit multiple preregistered kill conditions; qwen3:8b was not run
